method: Overpass power=line/minor_line/cable ways with a voltage tag, densified to 0.3 km steps and indexed to every res-6 cell they cross (max voltage kept); power=substation and power=plant features indexed by their centre.
limitations: Volunteer-mapped; coverage and voltage tagging vary. A cell with no mapped line may still have one.
Voltage is not spare capacity or a connection offer; capacity is inferred from voltage by the backend.
Underground distribution cables are rarely mapped.
